summary: Iteration 2 regression + new feature testing for Castellon Septic Services (palette swap + 12 new pages). Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passed against admin@castellon.com (test file updated for new admin email). All public + admin endpoints verified — no regression. Frontend: Landing page renders new Forest Green/Cream/Brass palette, real-cost-section visible with cost-cards 01/02/03 and CTA navigating to /book. All 4 service detail pages (/services/residential-septic, /commercial-septic, /grease-trap, /emergency) render with correct data-testid='service-page-{key}' and proper headlines. All 8 area pages (/areas/spokane-wa, /spokane-valley-wa, /cheney-wa, /deer-park-wa, /coeur-dalene-id, /post-falls-id, /hayden-id, /sandpoint-id) render with hero, stats, and area-page-{slug} testid. Invalid slugs /services/foo and /areas/bar correctly redirect to /. Footer navigation works (footer-service-grease_trap → /services/grease-trap; footer-area-coeur-dalene-id → /areas/coeur-dalene-id). area-link-spokane-valley-wa from landing navigates correctly. Booking flow completed end-to-end (service→date→slot→info→confirmed) using correct testids (service-select-residential, cal-day-{ymd}, slot-{time}, step-3-submit, step-4). Quote /quote submits successfully. Admin login at /admin/login with admin@castellon.com / Catellon2026! succeeds and all 3 tabs (tab-calendar, tab-quotes, tab-settings) render. Zero console errors during testing.

issues: The hero truck image (Unsplash photo at images.unsplash.com/photo-1757191462578-7c59fa85b016) clearly displays competitor branding 'Honey Bucket' on the vacuum tank. Highly visible on the homepage. Recommend replacing with a brand-neutral truck image or a real Castellon-branded photo.

H1 markup 'Septic Pumping In
{city}' produces a visual line break ('In' then city), but text-content reads as 'InSpokane' (no space). Visually acceptable, but consider 'Septic Pumping in {city}' (lowercase 'in', with a space) for cleaner copy/SEO.

action_items: (Optional) Replace homepage hero image to remove visible 'Honey Bucket' competitor branding.
(Optional minor) Tweak Area page H1 markup so the text-content has a space — purely an SEO/copy nicety.
critical_code_review_comments: Same standing items as iteration 1: CORS allow_origins='*' with credentials=True; cookie secure=False (fine in preview, must be True in prod); no brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login; /api/auth/me triggers 401 toast on public pages — consider gating that call to admin routes only.

New page code (ServicePage.jsx, AreaPage.jsx) is clean: uses Navigate to='/' for unknown slugs (good UX), scrolls to top on mount, sets document.title for SEO, uses Object.values lookup or direct dict key — both efficient.
Service-key→slug mapping is duplicated implicitly between Landing.jsx and SERVICE_PAGES — small risk if a service is added; would be cleaner to centralize the slug<->key map.

AreaPage H1: literal '
' between 'In' and city causes adjacent-word concatenation in plain-text — purely cosmetic for accessibility tools/screen-readers.
test_credentials: admin@castellon.com / Catellon2026! (seeded from backend/.env on startup)
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_-prefixed booking + quote during UI testing via admin DELETE endpoints. No residual test data remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Booking flow correct testids: service-select-{key} (NOT service-option-), cal-day-{YYYY-MM-DD}, slot-{HH:MM}, step-1-next, step-2-next, step-2-back, step-3-submit (NOT step-3-confirm), step-4. Quote uses quote-name/quote-phone/quote-message/quote-submit. Admin tabs: tab-calendar/tab-quotes/tab-settings. Service slug map: residential→residential-septic, commercial→commercial-septic, grease_trap→grease-trap, emergency→emergency. Area slug list: spokane-wa, spokane-valley-wa, cheney-wa, deer-park-wa, coeur-dalene-id, post-falls-id, hayden-id, sandpoint-id. Real cost CTA testid: real-cost-cta (link to /book).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional defects. Two cosmetic observations only (competitor branding on stock image; H1 line-break text-concatenation).
